core.title: Cut Nail Colonial Hook, Acorn AM5BP
tags: Acorn Cut Nail Smooth Iron Colonial Hooks

text.description_html:
Acorn AM5BP, Cut Nail Smooth Iron Colonial Hook

The rustic styling makes the Cut Nail Colonial Hook perfect for traditional decors. The 5" hook is made out of iron with a smooth, matte black finish. A hook such as this is as useful in the kitchen as it is in the bathroom. A stylish way to hang a robe, towels, or even a lady's purse, it's a beautiful way to keep things off the floor in any room.

Features and Specifications of the Cut Nail Colonial Hook:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 3"

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook and mounting screw.
